page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmg5s.24xlarge is a bare-metal class virtualized instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8163 processors running at a baseline clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers between the instance and external storage volumes or other network resources.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high core density offer predictable performance for enterprise workloads without the resource contention typical of shared-core environments. The balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio makes this server suitable for general-purpose enterprise applications, large-scale web serving, container orchestration, and medium-sized database deployments that do not require local NVMe drives.
